run_install_kernel: run the install_kernel script to auto install the correct auto round kernel library for your torch version
get_torch_minor: get the torch major minor version string from the installed torch package
get_auto_round_minor: get the auto round major minor version string from the installed auto round package
review_KERNEL_MAP: review the KERNEL_MAP that maps torch minor versions to auto round lib package version constraints
refactor_main: refactor the main function to support additional torch versions or custom kernel package installation logic
